title: 第8章 没那皇帝命，得了皇帝病
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

正追着钟离珟脚步的昭杺柠，突然感觉后背发寒。

她急忙回头，却发现身后根本没有人，就是刚刚站那的蓝莘也不见了。

【宿主，你看什么呢？】

“总感觉有人想害朕。”昭杺柠嘀咕。

【没那皇帝命，得了皇帝病】

“我真想给你屏蔽了。”昭杺柠是真的不喜欢这嘴碎系统。

【宿主，好机会啊】

系统却是惊喜喊着，催促着昭杺柠：

【宿主你现在走钟离珟身后，这距离是个好机会，你抬脚就能往他屁股踹去，如此受辱，他肯定会愤怒到追杀你的】

“你闭嘴，不要干扰我的任务进度。”昭杺柠沉声警告：“忘记我们刚刚说好的，任务我会做，但任务怎么做你别管。”

【行吧行吧】

见自己完全蛊惑不动昭杺柠，系统也有些泄气。

此刻，系统动着脑筋，它知道它得换个办法，才有可能让昭杺柠在星灵大陆积极惹事闯祸了。

不知道系统又开始算计自己了，见系统总算不出声了，昭杺柠只当得了个清净。

紧接着，她快步追上钟离珟的步子：“未婚夫，你等等我呀。”

“未婚夫，你走这么快做什么？”

昭杺柠的呼唤，让路过的问剑峰弟子都闻声停了下来。

一见昭杺柠喊的居然是他们那个凶名远扬的小师叔，各个惊悚呆在原地。

“不是说小师叔的未婚妻找了两年都没找到吗？”有弟子震惊看着昭杺柠，询问同门：“那这是谁啊，小师婶吗？”

“对啊，我之前就听说了，天道姻缘刚出现，小师叔就急着在星灵大陆寻找未婚妻了，只不过找了两年连人影都没看见，当时还有传闻说是小师叔名声太凶，所以小师叔这个未婚妻害怕躲起来了。”

“所以现在这个跟小师叔走一起的女子，就是那个躲了小师叔两年的小师婶？她不继续躲了吗？”

“应该不是不想躲了吧，估计是被小师叔找到了，没机会躲了，毕竟小师叔那么凶。”有弟子猜测。

“你们是谁的弟子。”钟离珟突然停下脚步，转身回看凑一起吃瓜的弟子们。

Zhao Hao Ning, who was chasing Zhong Lizui, suddenly felt a chill on his back.

She hurriedly turned around, only to find that there was no one behind her. Even Lan Xin, who was standing there just now, was gone.

[Host, what are you looking at?】

"I always feel like someone wants to harm me." Zhao Hao Ning muttered.

[Without the emperor’s life, I got the emperor’s disease]

"I really want to block you." Zhao Hao Ning really doesn't like this nonsense system.

[Host, what a great opportunity]

The system shouted in surprise, urging Zhao Hao Ning:

[Host, you are walking behind Zhong Lizou now. This distance is a good opportunity. You can kick his butt with your foot. If you are so humiliated, he will definitely be angry enough to chase you.]

"Shut up and don't interfere with the progress of my mission." Zhao Hao Ning warned in a deep voice: "Forget what we just said, I will complete the mission, but you don't have to worry about how the mission is done."

【Okay, okay, okay】

Seeing that he could not move Zhao Hao Ning completely, the system was also a little discouraged.

At this moment, the system was thinking hard, and it knew that it had to find another way to make it possible for Zhao Hao Ning to actively cause trouble in the Protoss Continent.

She didn't know that the system was plotting against her again. Seeing that the system had finally silenced her, Zhao Hao Ning could only pretend to be innocent.

Then, she quickly caught up with Zhong Lizui: "Fiancé, wait for me."

"Fiancé, why are you leaving so quickly?"

Zhao Hao Ning's call made all the Wenjian Peak disciples passing by stop when they heard the sound.

When they saw that the person Zhao Hao Ning was shouting was actually their notorious junior uncle, everyone froze in shock.

"Didn't you say that Junior Master Uncle's fiancée has not been found after two years of searching?" Some disciples looked at Zhao Hao Ning in shock and asked fellow disciples: "Then who is this, Junior Senior Auntie?"

"Yes, I heard it before. As soon as the marriage between heaven and earth appeared, my junior uncle was eager to find his fiancée in the Star Spirit Continent. However, he did not even see her for two years. At that time, there were rumors that his reputation was too fierce, so his fiancée was afraid and was hiding."

"So the woman who is now walking with my junior uncle is the same young junior aunt who has been hiding from my junior uncle for two years? Isn't she going to continue hiding?"

"It's probably because he didn't want to hide. He was probably found by his junior uncle and had no chance to hide. After all, his junior junior uncle is so fierce." Some disciples speculated.

"Whose disciples are you?" Zhong Lizui suddenly stopped and turned around to look back at the disciples who were eating melon together.
